definition: The AI Futures Project is a nonprofit research organization based in the United States that specializes in forecasting the development and societal impact of advanced artificial intelligence.
details: The organization is best known for its 2025 scenario forecast, AI 2027, which examines the potential near-term emergence of artificial general intelligence (AGI) and its possible global consequences.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is AI Futures Project.
